answer: The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, diluted when peers disagree. A mesa of per-task receipts records who did what, and the vault of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The meadow of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
